hook.en: Air molecules move at about 500 metres per second, yet the smell of agarbatti takes many seconds to cross a room. They keep bumping into each other.
hook.kn: ಗಾಳಿಯ ಅಣುಗಳು ಸೆಕೆಂಡಿಗೆ ಸುಮಾರು 500 ಮೀಟರ್ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದರೂ ಅಗರಬತ್ತಿಯ ವಾಸನೆ ಕೋಣೆ ದಾಟಲು ಹಲವು ಸೆಕೆಂಡು ಬೇಕು. ಅವು ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಡಿಕ್ಕಿ ಹೊಡೆಯುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: Air molecules move at about 500 metres per second, yet the smell of agarbatti takes many seconds to cross a room. They keep bumping into each other. In this lesson: Define mean free path.
Use l equals 1 over (the square root of 2 n pi d squared).

body.en: The *mean free path* l is the average distance a molecule travels between two successive collisions. For molecules of diameter d and number density n, l = 1/(√2 nπd²). It is longer when the gas is thinner (smaller n) and when the molecules are smaller. In air at STP it is of the order of 10⁻⁷ m, hundreds of times the size of a molecule.
body.kn: ಎರಡು ಸತತ ಘರ್ಷಣೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಅಣು ಸಾಗುವ ಸರಾಸರಿ ದೂರವೇ ಸರಾಸರಿ ಮುಕ್ತ ಪಥ: l = 1/(√2 nπd²). ಅನಿಲ ವಿರಳವಾದಷ್ಟು ಮತ್ತು ಅಣು ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾದಷ್ಟು l ಹೆಚ್ಚು.

say.en: The mean free path l is the average distance a molecule travels between two successive collisions. For molecules of diameter d and number density n, l equals 1 over (the square root of 2 n pi d squared). It is longer when the gas is thinner smaller n and when the molecules are smaller. In air at STP it is of the order of 10 to the power minus 7 metres, hundreds of times the size of a molecule. l is proportional to 1 over n and l is proportional to 1 over d squared.
say.kn: ಎರಡು ಸತತ ಘರ್ಷಣೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಅಣು ಸಾಗುವ ಸರಾಸರಿ ದೂರವೇ ಸರಾಸರಿ ಮುಕ್ತ ಪಥ: l equals 1 over (the square root of 2 n pi d squared). ಅನಿಲ ವಿರಳವಾದಷ್ಟು ಮತ್ತು ಅಣು ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾದಷ್ಟು l ಹೆಚ್ಚು.

say.en: At fixed T, n is proportional to P, so l is proportional to 1 over P.
A molecule zig-zags through the gas, changing direction at each collision. The average straight run is the mean free path.
A molecule of diameter d hits any molecule whose centre lies within d of its path. In time Δt it sweeps a cylinder of volume pi d squared v Δt.
Collisions in that time: n pi d squared v Δt. Dividing the distance by this, with a root 2 for the motion of the others:
For air at STP, n is about 2.7 times ten to the 25 per cubic metre and d about 2 times ten to the minus 10 metres. The mean free path is about 209 nanometres: a thousand molecular diameters.
At fixed temperature, n is proportional to pressure, so the mean free path is inversely proportional to pressure.

problem.en: Find the mean free path of molecules of diameter 3 × 10⁻¹⁰ m in a gas with n = 2.7 × 10²⁵ m⁻³.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the mean free path of molecules of diameter 3 × 10⁻¹⁰ m in a gas with n = 2.7 × 10²⁵ m⁻³.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find the mean free path of molecules of diameter 3 times 10 to the power minus 10 metres in a gas with n equals 2.7 times 10 to the power 25 metres to the power minus 3.
pi d squared equals 3.14 times 9 times 10 to the power minus 20 equals 2.83 times 10 to the power minus 19 square metres.

the square root of 2 n pi d squared equals 1.414 times 2.7 times 10 to the power 25 times 2.83 times 10 to the power minus 19 is approximately 1.08 times 10 to the power 7 metres to the power minus 1.
l equals 1 over (1.08 times 10 to the power 7) is approximately 9.3 times 10 to the power minus 8 metres.
So the answer is About 9 times 10 to the power minus 8 metres.
